column1: # The recall rep table (bead tla-1sh7.2, epic tla-1sh7).
# 120 reps over 37 of the 38 constructs in the four value-producing families
# of drill/INVENTORY.md: core 16, functions-records 11, sets 9, sequences 2.
# K008, bullet-point boolean notation, has no row, and why is at the bottom.
# Rows are tab-delimited and carry the literal first field REP, so prose in
# this file can never be read as data. Six fields, in order:
#   3  construct     K001-K105, resolving to a drill/INVENTORY.md row
#   5  prompt       English, naming none of the notation it asks for
# Read rows with awk -F'\t' or cut, never with IFS=$'\t' read.
# FIELD 5 IS THE FIELD THAT DECIDES WHETHER A REP IS A REP. It states a need
# and names none of the notation that answers it. Several reps share a
# construct on purpose and are phrased differently each time, so what gets
# retrieved is the fact rather than the sentence.
# THE GRADE IS VALUE EQUALITY, so any expression with the canonical's value
# scores 0. For most of these constructs that is the point. For the seven
# definition forms, K001 K071 K072 K073 K074 K075 K076, it is a real limit:
# each canonical is wrapped in a LET, because a bare definition is not an
# expression and scores 150, and each one returns a function or a set rather
# than a scalar so that the short way round is at least expensive. Even so,
# value equality cannot see that a definition was written. Those rows drill
# the construct; they do not gate it.

column1: # K008, bullet-point boolean notation, has no row and cannot have one here.
# The construct IS the layout: stacked /\ or \/ lines whose indentation is
# meaningful. Two things stop it. A tab-delimited row is one line, so field 6
# cannot carry the line breaks the layout is made of. And value equality
# grades the value, which is a truth value either way, so even folded onto one
# line the bulleted form and the infix form are the same answer. Measured:
# a canonical of (/\ TRUE /\ 1 = 1) = TRUE scores rc 0, exactly as the infix
# form does, so nothing distinguishes them. Grading it needs a check on the
# submitted TEXT rather than on its value.
